name: AI Autoplayer
description: Adds an AI button to the level page that plays the level until it beats it, then saves the winning run to your PC.

segment-ticks.name: Decision Segment (ticks)
segment-ticks.description: How many physics ticks (240 per second) the AI commits to between checkpoints. Smaller = finer control but slower search.

input-resolution.name: Input Positions per Segment
input-resolution.description: How many different moments inside each segment the AI tries clicking/releasing at. Higher = more precise timing, but much slower.

sim-speed.name: AI Game Speed
sim-speed.description: Speeds the game up while the AI is searching (1 = normal speed). The saved run is unaffected.

max-attempts.name: Max Attempts
max-attempts.description: The AI gives up after this many deaths.

playback-practice.name: Replay in Practice Mode
playback-practice.description: Play saved AI runs back in practice mode so they never count as a real completion (recommended).

show-status.name: Show AI Status
show-status.description: Show the attempt counter and progress while the AI plays.
